_prefix: Make a scene illustration for a story event in my game, in this image's exact art style: high resolution shaded pixel art, gritty, dark and desaturated, muted colors, same lighting as the reference. A wide cinematic establishing shot from a slightly elevated angle, in a grim dark-fantasy world where an undead lich's skeletal army wars against a holy human crusade. Scene:
_suffix: Muted charcoal, mud, ash, bone and muddy green; saturated colour only in magic light and firelight (sickly necrotic green, pale candle gold, torch orange). Detailed pixel-art environment with readable silhouettes and strong depth. No text, no letters, no UI, no border, no frame.
village: a small farming village at night with a broken wooden palisade, a stone chapel with a silent bell tower, thatched roofs smouldering, frightened villagers huddled in the muddy square while a ring of skeleton warriors with green glowing eyes stands around them.
chapel: a lonely stone chapel in a misty forest hollow, its doors open, a golden reliquary glowing softly on the altar inside, cracked crypt slabs in the floor leaking pale light, a heavy iron-bound tithe chest beside the altar.
deserters: a muddy crossroads under a grey sky with an old wooden gibbet, a small band of ragged crusader deserters who have thrown away their white tabards, kneeling and pleading, surrounded by skeletal scouts with green eyes.
siegecamp: an abandoned crusader siege camp in the mud: half-built battering rams and a wooden trebuchet, stacked war drums beside dying campfires, white tents with red crosses torn and flapping, a row of freshly dug graves at the edge.
necromancer: the shattered top floor of a necromancer's stone tower, broken glowing green phylactery jars scattered on the floor, a defeated robed necromancer kneeling, his frightened apprentices cowering behind him among bookshelves and candles.
plague: a lone covered cart heaped with shrouded bodies stopped on a muddy road through dead trees, thick sickly yellow-green miasma rolling off it, crows on the wheels, the road winding east toward distant crusader campfires.
pilgrim: a blind old pilgrim in a grey hooded robe with milky white eyes, holding up a lantern with a warm holy golden flame, walking calmly along a road at dusk while towering skeleton warriors stand silently on either side of the road watching him.
gravediggers: three gravediggers in muddy aprons with shovels under a small white flag, pushing a wooden handcart piled with shrouded bodies up to the black gate of a necropolis fortress, an undead guard looking down at them.
hangedoak: a huge twisted black oak at a lonely crossroads at night, hung with old ropes and swaying silhouettes of hanged men, crows on every branch, faint ghostly green wisps drifting from the branches.
caravan: a gaudy painted wooden caravan wagon hung with bells, bone charms and lanterns, stopped at the edge of a dark swamp road, a smiling merchant woman with many rings displaying curios on a folding table.
ossuary: a vast underground ossuary: walls and arches built of stacked skulls and bones, narrow galleries descending into darkness, a broken stone ceiling where diggers have broken through, a cold green glow from far below.
fenwitch: a crooked witch's hut standing on tall bone stilts in a foggy fen, a green fire under a bubbling iron cauldron, hanging herbs and skulls, an ancient hunched witch stirring the pot, reeds and black water all around.
ditchknight: a wounded crusader knight in white and gold plate lying in a muddy roadside ditch beside his dead horse, gripping his sword, while dark skeletal shapes gather on the road above him in the rain.
wolves: a gaunt starving grey wolf pack sitting in a ring around an undead war camp at night, yellow eyes glowing in the dark, skeleton sentries and green campfire light, bare trees and snow-dusted mud.
bonemarket: a secret night market of necromancers in a flooded stone quarry, hooded figures at wooden stalls selling bones, jars of hearts and skulls, green lanterns reflected in black water.
harvest: a market town celebrating a harvest festival at night, paper lanterns strung over the square, stacked grain sacks and supply carts for the crusade, dancing villagers, seen from a dark ridge where a cloaked hooded figure watches.
crows: thousands of black crows covering a ruined battlefield and the stone battlements of a necropolis gatehouse, one large crow standing forward on the parapet like a speaker addressing an assembly.
tourney: a medieval jousting tournament in a sunny meadow behind the lines: striped tents, colourful pennants, knights on armoured horses with lances, wooden stands full of nobles, a herald with a trumpet.
courier: a crusader courier fallen from his horse on a misty road at dawn, a leather satchel and a letter sealed with white wax lying in the mud, spectral wraiths hovering over him.
bishopgambit: an old stone bridge over a dark river at dusk, a proud bishop in white and gold vestments with a tall mitre standing in the middle with a small honour guard of knights, wary, looking around.
returnpilgrim: the same old pilgrim, now with clear shining eyes, standing at the black gate of a necropolis fortress holding his holy lantern, skeleton guards hesitating before him, dawn light behind him.
countess: an elegant black carriage drawn by black horses arriving at midnight before a dark necropolis gate, a pale aristocratic vampire countess in a crimson gown stepping out, bats circling in the moonlight.
countessprice: the gothic hall of a vampire countess's castle, a long banquet table with crimson candles and goblets, the countess seated at the head in a high-backed throne, her pale children standing in the shadows.
bells: a tall stone bell tower on a hilltop at dusk with great bronze bells hanging in its open belfry, loose ropes hanging, skeletal soldiers standing in the courtyard below, three valleys stretching away into mist.
alchemist: an alchemist's laboratory inside a burnt-out water mill, shelves of glowing bottles and phials in red and green, copper stills and bubbling flasks, a wild-haired alchemist grinning with a phial held up.
abbey: a drowned abbey in a dark flooded valley, only its bell tower and the tip of the roof rising from still black water, faint ghostly monks visible beneath the surface, a ruined dam in the distance.
headsman: an old burly executioner in a leather apron sitting calmly on a wooden chopping block outside a small cottage, a huge axe leaning beside him, smoking a pipe, autumn trees and grey sky.
doubt: a young paladin without his helmet standing alone in a burnt field, his white tabard stained, his sword point down in the earth, looking at a ruined village in the distance with a troubled face.
pyre: a village square with a great stacked wooden pyre and stakes, stern inquisitors in black wide-brimmed hats holding torches, a crowd watching from the shadows, smoke rising into a dark sky.
giant: a huge grassy hill shaped like a sleeping stone giant lying on its side, a crown of standing stones on its brow, an undead army camped on its slope, faint glowing runes on its exposed stone shoulder.
statue: a roofless ruined chapel with a marble statue of a female saint with a golden halo, tears running from her stone eyes and pooling at her feet, shafts of pale light, ivy on the broken walls.
duel: a narrow stone bridge over a gorge with a lone knight-errant in silver mail holding the middle, his shield raised, skeleton warriors massed on the near bank, mist in the gorge below.
smith: a captured crusader blacksmith's forge inside a dark keep: glowing anvil, bellows, sparks, a muscular sullen smith hammering iron, undead guards watching, weapons and armour stacked around.
fort: an empty crusader border fortress of pale stone with tall towers and open gates, banners hanging limp, a deserted courtyard with racks of weapons, the undead host approaching on the road below.
blackship: a rotting black-sailed sailing ship run aground in a grey estuary at low tide, its tattered sails black, a dead crew of skeletal sailors still standing at their posts on deck, fog over the water.
relic: a golden crystal reliquary holding a single saint's finger bone, glowing with soft holy light, resting on a captured baggage cart among crusader banners and chests, undead hands reaching toward it.
eclipse: a total solar eclipse over a wide battlefield, the black sun with a thin ring of light, the land in eerie twilight, graves and burial mounds stirring with green light, kneeling crusaders far away.
herald: a herald in cloth-of-gold riding a white horse under a white banner of truce toward the black gate of a necropolis, skeletal archers watching from the walls, a long road behind him.
oldlich: a vast tomb carved inside a mountain, an ancient crumbling lich skeleton on a stone throne with a tarnished crown, dust and cobwebs, a faint green glow in its eye sockets, piles of old treasure.
mirror: a ruined observatory with a broken domed roof open to the stars, a tall ornate mirror of black glass in its centre, ghostly faces and pale souls pressing against the inside of the glass.
famine: a long column of ragged starving refugees shuffling along a muddy road across a bleak grey plain, carts, old people and children, a crusader camp on one horizon and a necropolis on the other.
oldfield: an ancient battlefield on a grassy ridge with seven burial barrows, rusted crowns, broken swords and helmets poking through the grass, standing stones, a pale moon, the undead host marching past.
